card.text: M19 is a globular star cluster in the Milky Way, about 8,340 parsecs away.

sources.quote: Messier 19 or M19 is a globular cluster in the constellation Ophiuchus.

introduction.text: M19 is drawn as 1,277 of its member stars, measured by Gaia; each dot sits at its sky position, at the cluster's distance.
